dedupe_keys.name: data and code of article an integrated hydro traffic modeling approach for assessing the impact of urban storm on road network performance

description: Qinlin Yan and colleagues publish drainage-network inputs and validation tables for an integrated hydro-traffic study. The January 2026 files are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. A ZIP contains reconstructed conduits, junctions, outfalls and river nodes intended for SWMM model construction. CSV files compare water depths inferred from crowdsourced photographs with simulated depths. Two Python notebooks provide result plots and a demonstration comparing weighted and unweighted network efficiency. These materials can calibrate urban flooding or test road-network performance measures. The public metadata do not establish the study location, storm dates, depth units or the complete traffic and drainage solver configuration. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package; model-epa-swmm identifies the relevant drainage simulator. The deposit should not be treated as a complete integrated-model archive. Files were not downloaded or run.
